overview: Indian economy as a developing economy, planning since 1951, NITI Aayog, growth vs distribution, HDI, environment and sustainable development: 29 official questions (2008-2024), 26 of them one-liners. Planning (14) is the core - plan targets, themes, novel ideas and bodies; 2019 had 9 items. Many 2008-2017 keys are unofficial, and 2024 brought statement-based HDI/SDG items.

traps.trap: [Theme word] Plan theme missing or adding one word
traps.spot: 'Faster and more inclusive' vs 'Faster, sustainable, inclusive'
traps.fix: 11th = faster and more inclusive; 12th adds sustainable

traps.spot: Planning Commission and NDC both offered
traps.fix: Planning Commission drafted; NDC prescribed guidelines and approved the Plan
Environmental Kuznets = degradation vs income (inverted U); Laffer tax; Lorenz inequality; Phillips inflation-unemployment

traps.trap: Index rank from the wrong edition
traps.fix: Rank depends on the report year: HDR 2010 India 119 of 169

traps.spot: IHDI 'below HDI with no inequality'; 'GDI below 1 means women ahead'
traps.fix: IHDI = HDI when no inequality; GDI < 1 = women behind; PHDI = planetary (intergenerational)

traps.trap: Agency swapped for an SDG tool
traps.spot: 'NITI Aayog developed the National Indicator Framework'
traps.fix: NIF = MoSPI; SDG India Index = NITI Aayog; decent work = SDG 8, not 10

techniques.name: Plan card
techniques.how: [Plan → years, model, theme, event] Keep one line per plan: 1st Harrod-Domar; 2nd Mahalanobis, forex crisis; 4th growth with stability; 5th garibi hatao; 1978 Rolling Plan; 10th monitorable targets; 11th inclusive; 12th sustainable.
techniques.example: Monitorable targets first set → Tenth Plan [group1-prelims-2017-paper1#5]; heavy-industry strategy → Mahalanobis [group1-prelims-2010#86]

techniques.name: Event-to-plan causation
techniques.how: Ask what crisis or regime change hit during the plan; it explains pruning, holidays or new ideas.
techniques.example: Second Plan pruned in 1957-58 → acute forex shortage [group1-prelims-2017-paper1#3]; Janata draft Sixth Plan → Rolling Plan [group1-prelims-2012#22]

techniques.name: Achieved vs target growth
techniques.how: Separate a plan's target from its achieved growth; 'highest achieved' was the 11th (~8%).
techniques.example: Highest GDP growth → 11th Plan; 12th fell short of 8% [group1-prelims-2023-paper1#64]

techniques.name: Definition source match
techniques.how: Classic definitions have one source; match the wording, not the topic.
techniques.example: 'needs of the present without compromising future generations' → Brundtland Report 1987 [group1-prelims-2019-paper1#61]

techniques.name: Approach keyword
techniques.how: NITI's approach words are bottom-up, cooperative and competitive federalism; drop top-down or one-size options.

12th Plan 2012-17: faster, more inclusive and sustainable growth
HDI by UNDP since 1990; HDR 2010 India 119 of 169
NIF by MoSPI; SDG India Index by NITI Aayog
checklist: Which plan? Place it by years and its signature theme.
Target or achievement? Read the stem verb.
Body question: drafts, approves, or advises?
Index question: which edition and which variant (HDI, IHDI, GDI, PHDI)?
Count every word of a plan theme option.
Do not build rules on items whose key is unofficial or 'per key' only.
